In the beginning, the Elder God [[Characters/Gods/Shao Daraan|Shao Daraan]] created the world and gave form and domain to the Gods. He turned creation and stewardship of his Astral realm to his children afterwards, but before he went dormant he created 12 special and powerful beings knows as the 12 Prime Creations. He considered them his purest and most beautiful beings and they are often referred to as "The Children of Daraan"
- [[Temporial]] the Chronoscale Dragon (Time Dragon)
- Tiurah the Comet (Elemental Spirit)
- Pyraeus the First Flame (Phoenix)
- Nyxia the Star Seeker ()
- Cosmosa the Astral Crystal ()
- Sylvaris the Forest Guardian
- Fyrnanth the Scale Father (Crystal Dragon)
- Aurathia the Lady of the Lake (Water Spirit)
